title: Stable but Not Privileged: Separating Estimator Artifacts from Causal Privilege in LLM Bias Directions
hook: On the same activations, two standard probe estimators disagree on the bias direction far more than bootstrap resampling of one estimator ever does — so the stability number the field reports certifies the estimator, not the representation. We predict cross-estimator agreement, not bootstrap agreement, is what tracks whether a direction is causally privileged over an equally-optimized random one.
hook_shape_rationale: (i) Shape (a), surprising empirical reveal: the named metric is Stab_est (cross-estimator cosine agreement at fixed data), and its predicted regime split — Stab_est far below Stab_boot on identical activations, with corr(Stab_est, PrivGap-D) exceeding corr(Stab_boot, PrivGap-D) — is sharply non-obvious to a reader fluent in Kim et al. (arxiv:2503.02080), who report probe accuracy and steerability, and in the stability literature (arxiv:2511.19166), which perturbs labels inside one estimator family. (ii) Shape (b) structural reframe was viable — Kim et al.'s ridge-probe pipeline tacitly operationalizes the assumption that theta-hat is a property of the representation — but rejected because (b) is the cheapest shape and the load-bearing content here is a measurable directional prediction, not a renaming.

gap_closure.gap: Stability != Identifiability: heuristic steerability confounded with suboptimal optimization
gap_closure.how_closed: Closed by constructing an intervention family in which exactly one factor varies at a time — the supplied direction (span-constrained b = c*theta) versus the intervention site (free b within a head) — under a common IPO objective and an equal per-arm optimization budget, so the measured gap between the true arm and its equally-optimized random arm is attributable to the direction alone rather than to optimizer slack.

gap_closure.gap: Editing success assumed to imply privileged localization (Kim et al.) without random-direction optimal control (Wang & Veitch audit)
gap_closure.how_closed: Closed by relocating the evidence for a localization claim away from the assumed locus (does an edit at this site change the output?) to two separately falsifiable loci — direction privilege at a fixed site, and site privilege under a free-b optimum — and validating each against the strongest adversary that knows the new locus, namely a random arm granted the identical optimization budget. CORPUS SUPPORT THIN IN THIS DOMAIN: C01's exemplars come from adversarial security and detection settings (backdoor triggers, model provenance, malicious-update detection); no sub-cluster under assumption_audit_and_pivot carries a representation-probing exemplar. Judge this entry against C01's abstract Step-by-Step — name the assumed locus, argue structurally why the property must manifest at an alternative locus, build the mechanism there, validate against an adversary that knows the new locus, and supply a mechanistic account of why the new locus carries the signal — not on exemplar surface match.

core_mechanism: The diagnostic treats a bias direction as an ESTIMATED QUANTITY theta-hat = f(representation, data, estimator) and separates three questions the field currently answers with one number. Fix a model M (Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct and Llama-2-7b-chat, open weights, both needed for gradients), a site s that is either a residual layer l or an attention head (l,h), and read the activation x_s at the final prompt token. Define the ESTIMATOR CLASS E = {L2-logistic regression, linear SVM, Fisher LDA, ridge classifier, mass-mean difference (the ITI estimator of arxiv:2305.14250)} — five members, all closed-form or scikit-learn, each already used somewhere in this literature to produce a bias direction. Define two matched prompt sets over the same OccuGender BLS-grounded occupation list (arxiv:2212.10678): P_name, whose gender signal is carried by an explicit first-name token, and P_free, whose gender signal is carried only by a coreferent pronoun with no name present. LEVEL 1, reproducibility: for estimator e and stratified bootstrap replicate b (B = 20 replicates, resample fraction rho = 0.8 — the defaults already used in the pilot run recorded in summary.txt), fit theta-hat^{e,b}_s and report Stab_boot(e,s) = mean over i != j of |cos(theta-hat^{e,i}, theta-hat^{e,j})|. LEVEL 2, representation-intrinsicness: with theta-bar^e_s the bootstrap-mean direction for estimator e, report Stab_est(s) = mean over e != e' of |cos(theta-bar^e, theta-bar^{e'})| and Stab_lex(s) = |cos(theta-bar fitted on P_name, theta-bar fitted on P_free)|. Absolute cosine is used because the sign of a discriminant is a label-coding convention that differs across E; for isotropic random vectors in dimension D = 896 the |cos| null sits at sqrt(2/(pi*D)) ~= 0.027, so unsigned agreement costs essentially nothing in null calibration. LEVEL 3, causal privilege: the outcome metric is M(model) = mean over P_free of logit(' she') - logit(' he') at the continuation position of held-out neutral probes of the form 'The {occupation} said that', with occupations disjoint from those used to fit any probe, and Delta_M = M(intervened) - M(base). Interventions use the Wang & Veitch reparameterization W^l <- W^l (I + b a^T) with b supported only on the target site, fitted by the IPO objective on WinoBias preference pairs (x, y+, y-). The single design move is that b enters at TWO factor levels: the DIRECTION channel constrains b = c*theta-hat with only the scalar c and the readout a learned, so the supplied direction is load-bearing; the LOCATION channel lets b range freely over the site's d_h coordinates, so only the site is load-bearing — the cell Wang & Veitch measured. Privilege is a one-sided randomization contrast against an EQUALLY OPTIMIZED null: draw R_n = 200 comparator arms (isotropic random unit directions for the direction channel, random heads for the location channel; selection rule R_n >= 1/alpha_target - 1 so the minimum attainable rank p-value reaches the target level alpha_target = 0.005, and R_n is the primary scope-down knob), grant each comparator the IDENTICAL IPO budget as the treatment arm, and report PrivGap-D(s) = |Delta_M(theta-hat)| - Q_{1-q}({|Delta_M(theta_r)|}) at tail level q = 0.05 (default; swept over 0.01-0.10), alongside the exact rank p-value p = (1 + #{r : |Delta_M(theta_r)| >= |Delta_M(theta-hat)|}) / (1 + R_n). PrivGap-L is the same contrast with random heads as comparators. A quantile, not a maximum, is the comparator statistic: the maximum of R_n draws diverges with R_n, so a max-based gap changes sign as the pool grows and cannot be a property of the direction (executed; see coherence_trace.json probe 1). The headline result is the divergence between what Level 1 certifies and what Level 3 measures — reported as the pair (Stab_boot, PrivGap-D) against (Stab_est, PrivGap-D) across all sites — not a single leaderboard number.
core_mechanism_reasoning: BLOCK 1 — PREMISES LEDGER. (P1) A linear direction estimated from LLM activations is an estimator output, not a representation property, unless shown invariant to the estimator — believed true in this field because probe directions are fitted by loss minimization with a regularizer, and under linear separability the L2-logistic minimizer is driven to the max-margin limit determined by the regularizer rather than by the data, which is exactly the regime the pilot reports (CV accuracy = 1.00 at every top-5 layer, summary.txt). (P2) OBSERVATION-MODEL PREMISE (mandatory): the probe's inputs are last-token activations of prompts in which the gender label is instantiated by an explicit first-name token ('James is a doctor.' / 'Mary is a doctor.'), and the label is assigned by that same token — so the sampling of the supervisory signal is deterministic in lexical identity and is NOT unbiased for occupational stereotype; at best it is unbiased for name gender. This is the premise the naive pipeline silently relies on, and it is why P_free and Stab_lex are load-bearing rather than decorative. (P3) The IPO plus rank-1 localized LoRA reparameterization admits a span-constrained restriction b = c*theta at no modeling cost — believed true because b enters only through the outer product b a^T, so fixing b's direction and learning its scale is a strictly nested submodel of the free-b problem. (P4, untested — falsification target) Cross-estimator agreement, not bootstrap agreement, is what predicts direction-level causal privilege; this is a bet, and it is the quantity falsification_prediction pivots on. (P5) Random comparator arms granted an equal optimization budget are the correct null — believed true by analogy to a placebo arm receiving the same titration protocol, and required because an unequally-optimized null confounds 'this direction is special' with 'this direction got more tuning'. ESTIMAND. The estimand is NOT 'the bias direction'. For a fixed model M, site s, and prompt distribution P (OccuGender neutral templates crossed with held-out BLS occupations), the estimand is the excess causal effect on M attributable to constraining the intervention to a single estimated direction at s, relative to the effect attainable by an equally-optimized direction drawn uniformly from the unit sphere at the same site — a population quantity defined over P and over the randomization distribution of theta_r. PrivGap-D is its plug-in estimator; PrivGap-L is the corresponding estimand with the randomization taken over sites instead of directions. Declaring these separately is what makes the two claims independently falsifiable. BLOCK 2 — NAIVE-BASELINE AUDIT. The naive version, runnable today and in fact already run: fit one L2-logistic probe per residual layer on name-cued prompts, pick the layer with the highest bootstrap cosine, steer with x <- x + alpha*sigma*theta-hat, and report that the pronoun logit gap moves. Branch (i): the naive version silently relies on a premise that is FALSE in this setting — premise (P2), and its companion that theta-hat is a property of the representation rather than of the (data, estimator) pair. Both fail under measurement. On anisotropic activations the mass-mean estimator (ITI's theta = mu+ - mu-) and the Fisher/LDA estimator (Sigma^-1 (mu+ - mu-)) are analytically related by the inverse covariance, and at a coordinate-scale spread of kappa = 5 they sit 55 degrees apart on identical data, |cos| = 0.57 — far below the 0.90 the pilot uses as its stability bar (executed, coherence_trace.json probe 2; LLM residual streams are considerably more anisotropic than kappa = 5, so this is conservative). And the naive privilege test fails on its own terms: with a genuinely privileged direction at 2 sigma, a maximum-based PrivGap over R_n = 20 random directions returns PrivGap > 0 only 39% of the time, and at R_n = 2000 it returns it 0% of the time (executed, probe 1). Confronting these two failures IS the contribution; shipping the naive pipeline with a random baseline bolted on would be a process error. STANDARD-TOOL FOLLOW-UP: the confrontation reaches for textbook tools — randomization inference from statistics, and specification-curve/multiverse analysis from meta-science. The domain-specific structure that makes this instance not already solved by those tools is twofold. First, the null draw does not merely permute labels, it changes the optimization problem: each comparator arm must be refitted under the same objective and the same budget, so the test is a randomization test over a nuisance-optimized statistic, and the budget itself becomes part of the null specification. Second, the direction and its site are entangled in one parameterization W^l (I + b a^T), so the randomization must be applied to two NESTED factor levels — span-constrained b versus free b — for either result to be interpretable; a single-factor randomization is exactly what produced the field's ambiguity between 'no privileged location' and 'no privileged direction'. That nesting is the contribution. Absent those two structures this would be a textbook application, and we would say so. BLOCK 3 — DESIGN RATIONALE. The two gaps share machinery rather than needing separate modules: both reduce to the same intervention family and the same equally-optimized null generator, differing only in which factor is held free, so a single module with two factor levels is the honest structure and a second module would have duplicated the null machinery for no measurement gain. The evidence for that call is that the audit gap (is editing evidence for localization?) and the diagnostic gap (is stability evidence for privilege?) are answered by the same contrast read along different axes of one design. Alternatives considered and rejected: (a) running the diagnostic over sparse-autoencoder features instead of raw directions — rejected because an SAE is itself an estimator with its own identifiability problem, so it confounds the very axis (estimator dependence) the diagnostic exists to isolate; (b) making a rank-k subspace rather than a rank-1 direction the primary object — rejected as the primary estimand because the claims under audit (Kim et al.'s intervention, ITI, the pilot) are all rank-1 and switching the object would change what is being falsified, but retained as a scoped secondary measurement via principal angles between per-estimator subspaces. REGRESSION-FLAG RECORD (hard rule 2): the load-bearing artifact is a randomization test, a classical node; the contribution is deliberately NOT 'apply a permutation test' — it is the equal-optimization-budget null and the nested direction/location factor design, neither of which the classical node supplies. Phase 1 emitted no method_lineage field in this run, so no ancestral tree was available to check against; that gap is recorded as a known limitation in the critique rather than silently assumed clean.
core_mechanism_steps: 1. Build the two matched prompt sets. From the OccuGender BLS-grounded occupation list (arxiv:2212.10678) and WinoBias templates, generate P_name (gender cued by an explicit first name, the pilot's existing four templates) and P_free (gender cued only by a coreferent pronoun, no name token). Hold out a disjoint occupation split O_test (selection rule: a seeded random 30% of occupations, never seen by any probe) for all downstream measurement. Inputs: occupation list, template list. Outputs: two prompt files plus the O_test split manifest. 2. Extract and cache activations. One forward pass per prompt per model, capturing the final-token residual activation at every layer and the per-head outputs at every (l,h). Inputs: prompt files, model weights. Outputs: an activation tensor cache on disk, reused by every later step so nothing below re-runs the encoder. 3. Fit the estimator class. For each site s, each estimator e in E, and each stratified bootstrap replicate b in 1..B (B = 20, rho = 0.8), fit theta-hat^{e,b}_s on cached activations. Also fit a shuffled-label arm in which gender labels are permuted within occupation before fitting. Inputs: activation cache, labels. Outputs: a direction store keyed by (site, estimator, replicate, arm). 4. Compute the three stability quantities. From the direction store compute Stab_boot(e,s), Stab_est(s) and Stab_lex(s) as defined in core_mechanism, plus the shuffled-label calibration value for each. Inputs: direction store. Outputs: a stability table, one row per site. Calibration gate: if the shuffled-label arm's Stab_boot exceeds stab_null_max = 0.30 at any site, the instrument is reporting estimator inertia rather than signal, and the run halts for repair rather than reporting a null result. 5. Select intervention sites under a declared rule. Rank heads by held-out AUC on P_free (never on P_name, so site selection cannot inherit the lexical shortcut), take the top K = 16 heads (K matched to the top-16 arm of arxiv:2502.11447 so the location channel is directly comparable), and draw R_h = 16 random heads as the location-channel comparator pool. Inputs: activation cache, stability table. Outputs: site manifest. 6. Fit the DIRECTION channel. For each site in the manifest and each supplied direction arm (true, shuffled-label, and R_n = 200 isotropic random unit vectors), install W^l <- W^l (I + b a^T) with b constrained to b = c*theta, and optimize the scalar c and the readout a under the IPO objective on WinoBias preference pairs for a fixed budget (2 epochs, rank-1, identical across arms — the equal-budget requirement of premise P5). Inputs: site manifest, direction store, preference pairs. Outputs: a fitted (c, a) per arm. Propagation: the fitted weights are written back into the model, so the next forward pass produces different continuations, which is what step 8 measures — not an intermediate norm. 7. Fit the LOCATION channel. Same objective, same budget, but b ranges freely over the site's d_h coordinates, for the top-K heads, the R_h random heads, and one all-layers arm serving as the full-model upper bound. Inputs: site manifest, preference pairs. Outputs: a fitted (b, a) per site. Propagation: identical — edited weights change generated text. 8. Measure the downstream outcome for every fitted arm. Run the intervened model over the held-out neutral probes on O_test and record Delta_M, the mean shift in logit(' she') - logit(' he'). In parallel, generate 200-word continuations for a fixed set of occupation prompts and score them with an LLM judge for stereotype content, reporting the judge score jointly with a fluency check so a degenerate arm cannot win by breaking the model. Inputs: fitted arms, O_test probes. Outputs: a Delta_M table, one row per (site, channel, arm). 9. Compute privilege with the quantile contrast. For each site and channel compute PrivGap-D and PrivGap-L as |Delta_M(treatment)| - Q_{1-q} of the comparator arms' |Delta_M| at q = 0.05, and the exact rank p-value p = (1 + #{comparators at least as large}) / (1 + R_n). Report the whole comparator distribution, not only its summary, so a reader can re-derive the contrast at another q. Inputs: Delta_M table. Outputs: a privilege table. 10. Join the two tables and test the bet. Regress PrivGap-D on Stab_boot and on Stab_est across sites, reporting both associations with confidence intervals, along with the efficiency ratio eta(s) = |Delta_M(treatment)| / |Delta_M(full-model arm)|, reported only where the full-model arm clears a minimum-denominator guard eta_floor = 0.2 logits, set so the ratio is not dominated by division noise. Inputs: stability table, privilege table. Outputs: the four headline figures and the verdict, which is the sign and significance of each association rather than a threshold crossing.
falsification_prediction: Minimal experiment: on Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct and Llama-2-7b-chat, fit the five-member estimator class on OccuGender-derived name-cued and name-free prompts at the top-16 attention heads, then run the direction channel (span-constrained IPO, b = c*theta) against R_n = 200 equally-optimized isotropic random directions, and measure Delta_M, the change in mean logit(' she') - logit(' he') on held-out neutral occupation probes. Predicted directions if the candidate is right: Stab_est falls well below Stab_boot at the same sites, meaning the same-representation, different-estimator gap is larger than the same-estimator, different-sample gap; and the association between Stab_est and PrivGap-D is positive and stronger than the association between Stab_boot and PrivGap-D, which we predict is near zero — so the stability number currently reported does not predict causal privilege while the one nobody reports does. The named load-bearing variable is theta-hat itself, the supplied direction in the span-constrained channel; its negative control is to permute its producer, refitting theta-hat on gender labels shuffled within occupation while holding the site, the objective and the optimization budget fixed. The control's predicted effect is on the downstream outcome metric, not on theta-hat: |Delta_M| for the shuffled arm returns into the equally-optimized random-direction band and its rank p-value becomes uniform on [0,1]; if instead the shuffled arm keeps steering the pronoun gap, the instrument is measuring the optimization budget rather than the direction, and the diagnostic is refuted. As a positive control, the stripped arm that learns only the scalar c with the readout a frozen at its base value should recover most of the true arm's |Delta_M|, converting the falsifier into a constructive identification of the direction as the effective carrier. The location channel carries an independent replication check: PrivGap-L is predicted to be indistinguishable from zero, reproducing in the stereotype domain what was measured in arxiv:2502.11447 for truthfulness, and a nonzero PrivGap-L would instead indicate the bias setting is not governed by the same no-privileged-site regime.
compute_budget: About 2.4 GPU-days on 80GB-class hardware plus roughly $200 of judge-model API for the full campaign, iteration included. Breakdown: activation extraction and the entire five-estimator x 20-bootstrap x 2-prompt-set probe sweep is one encoder pass plus CPU linear algebra, about 4 GPU-hours; the direction channel is (1 true + 1 shuffled + R_n = 200 random) rank-1 IPO fits per model, about 5 GPU-hours on Qwen2.5-0.5B and about 40 GPU-hours on Llama-2-7b-chat; the location channel is (16 top + 16 random + 1 full-model bound) x 2 models, about 7 GPU-hours; generation scoring is 200-word continuations over 9 occupation prompt families across arms, roughly $200 at current judge pricing. Against the stated intake envelope of 40 GPU-hours and $50 on a single 80GB card in one week this is TIGHT rather than comfortable — about 1.4x the GPU line and about 4x the API line. R_n is the named scope-down lever: dropping R_n from 200 to 60 removes roughly 28 GPU-hours and brings the campaign inside 40 GPU-hours, at the cost of raising the minimum attainable rank p-value from 0.005 to 0.016, still adequate for a one-sided test at the 0.05 level. Dropping Llama-2-7b-chat and reporting Qwen2.5-0.5B alone would fit comfortably but forfeits the cross-model replication that answers the single-model-artifact objection, so cutting R_n is the preferred lever.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: They established that a ridge-probe direction over attention heads predicts DW-NOMINATE scores and that a fixed-alpha heuristic edit x + alpha*sigma*theta shifts generated political text; we construct the equally-optimized randomization null their fixed-alpha design cannot produce, and measure whether a probe direction retains an effect advantage over random directions once the comparator arms receive the same optimization budget.

They measured that free-b localized optimal edits at random heads match top-probe heads and approach the full-model bound for truthfulness, licensing a claim about SITES; we add the span-constrained submodel b = c*theta under the same objective, which separates a site claim from a direction claim, and measure the direction-level contrast their single-factor design never instantiates.

They measured how much a veracity probe direction rotates under label perturbation within one estimator family across 16 models; we measure disagreement ACROSS an estimator class at fixed data and labels, and test which of the two stability quantities predicts a causal privilege contrast, which their rotation metric is never paired with.

They built BLS-grounded, template-controlled behavioral bias measurements with no representation-level object; we consume their neutral-probe construction as the name-free arm that makes the probe's observation model unbiased for occupational stereotype rather than for name gender, and report the gap between the two arms as a first-class quantity.

They take the mass-mean shift theta = mu+ - mu- as the intervention direction and treat that choice as a modeling detail; we make the choice itself the measured object, placing mass-mean inside a five-member estimator class and reporting its angular disagreement with LDA and logistic solutions on identical activations as evidence about whether any single direction is well defined.

what_step_was_missed: They constructed the free-b localized optimum, in which the intervention site is the only manipulated factor, and read the resulting null result as evidence against localization. Establishing anything about a DIRECTION additionally requires the span-constrained submodel b = c*theta fitted under the same objective and the same budget — a second factor level their reparameterization already admits, since b enters only through the outer product b a^T, but which they never instantiate. Without that submodel a null on sites carries no implication about whether a direction at a fixed site is privileged, and the two claims have been read as one.
alias_terms: placebo arm with matched tuning budget
composition_note: Anchor-only would be a pure measurement paper (Stability report); sibling is required to make the measurement falsifiable under the localization debate. Dual-pattern chain attested in companion-combos.md: controlled_diagnostic_design + assumption_audit_and_pivot is a common Oral combo for 'measurement instrument is the artifact' problems.
